T:P1.2.text: Visit G-III Apparel Group online to learn about our footprint as a global fashion leader with a portfolio of over 30 licensed and owned brands.

T:P1.3.text: As a global leader in fashion, we unlock the value of our 30+ brands through our team’s agility and innovation.

T:P1.4.text: We are global experts in design, sourcing, distribution and marketing, bringing excitement and confidence to customers through the fashion we create.

T:P1.5.text: Brands Across a Range of Categories

T:P1.6.text: With over 30 owned and licensed global brands in our portfolio, our strengths across the full product life cycle enable us to unlock their value and fuel growth.

T:P1.7.text: Marc Jacobs is an iconic American fashion house known for its fearless designs and playful approach to luxury. Since its inception the brand has created a lasting impact on the fashion industry, becoming synonymous with creativity, individuality, and timeless craftsmanship. Marc Jacobs continues to influence the world of fashion with its innovative vision and bold approach to style.

T:P1.8.text: When Donna Karan launched her first collection she started with a city, Seven Easy Pieces, and the power of a woman—and she revolutionized the way women dress.

T:P1.9.text: the House of Karl Lagerfeld shares the iconic vision and design aesthetic of its namesake, fused with a contemporary, forward-looking spirit.

T:P1.10.text: From the house founded by Donna Karan DKNY emerged.

T:P1.11.text: Vilebrequin cultivates a spirit of refinement and fantasy, staying true to the casual charm the house was founded on in St. Tropez. Vilebrequin joined the G-III portfolio providing the company with a new core competency and a robust global retail network.

T:P1.12.text: G-III’s success comes from our agility, drive and dedication to delivering for our customers. Every member of the team brings a unique point of view that adds something special to our company and the products we create.

T:P2.3.text: G-III excels at bringing excitement and confidence to customers through the fashion we create. We are global experts in design, sourcing, distribution and marketing, which enables us to fuel the growth of a substantial portfolio of brands. With more than 30 licensed and owned brands, including some of the most sought-after names in global fashion, our success is driven by our team’s entrepreneurial spirit and our deep relationships across the industry.

C:P1.3.text: We are a live social shopping company that redefines the shopping experience through video-driven commerce on every screen, from smartphones and tablets to laptops and TVs.

C:P1.4.text: We bring innovative products, compelling content, and unforgettable moments to millions of shoppers worldwide via social platforms, streaming apps, ecommerce sites and TV channels. We make every screen a doorway to discovery, delight and community.

C:P1.5.text: We are six leading retail brands, reaching more than 200 million homes worldwide via 15 television networks, which are widely available on cable/satellite TV, free over-the-air TV, and FAST and other digital livestreaming TV.

C:P1.6.text: We also reach multiple customers via TikTok Shop, our QVC+ and HSN+ streaming experience, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, websites, mobile apps, print catalogs, and in-store destinations.

C:P3.2.text: A More Sustainable Way to Retail

C:P3.3.text: We use the power of our platforms to inspire a more sustainable way to retail: intentionally inclusive, entrepreneurially driven, responsibly curated and waste-smart.

C:P3.4.text: Every product has a story, a human connection. A dream fulfilled; a bond made. At QVC Group, we don’t just sell things. We connect dreamers with discoverers; designers and innovators with shoppers looking for unique experiences that enrich life’s everyday moments. But with relationships comes responsibility. For us, that responsibility has always meant making sure that these moments of joy also help build a better world.

C:P3.5.text: Now, we’re raising our game even further.

C:P3.6.text: We’re building an intentionally inclusive work culture where differences drive innovation. We’re supporting entrepreneurs of all backgrounds so startups become sustainable sources of income and inspiration and build community resilience. We’re conserving energy by recycling, reusing, and shifting our plastic use so that our oceans can thrive again. And we’re purposefully sourcing products that are made ethically and sustainably.

C:P3.7.text: In other words, we see a new path forward. A new way of retailing that creates moments of joy and a better world. Powered by our purpose and principles. Moving us forward.

C:P3.8.text: QVC Group’s Global Impact team seeks to embed inclusion, sustainability, and social responsibility into all aspects of our business. This strategy prioritizes actions in three key areas that the company’s stakeholders have deemed to be important, and where the company believes it can deliver the largest impact:

C:P3.9.text: Protecting Our Environment to reduce our impact on the climate and ecosystems

C:P3.10.text: Championing Empowerment and Belonging to include everyone in the future of retail

C:P3.11.text: Curating Product Responsibly to ensure that what we sell respects people and planet

C:P3.12.text: As we work to advance our strategy, we hold ourselves to the highest standards of business ethics, customer service and privacy, and product safety and quality.

C:P3.13.text: Creating a more sustainable way to retail means looking for ways to minimize our environmental impact.
